Container.Name: home-assistant-dashboard
Container.Overview: Home Assistant Dashboard Builder. A touchscreen dashboard for Home Assistant with widgets, a screensaver, and a calendar.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port. Use a different port (e.g. 3001) when you run a second instance.

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Location for the SQLite database and uploaded images.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: SQLite path inside the container. The image default is file:/data/app.db. A value set here overrides that default.

Config.Name: APP_SECRET
Config.Description: Required. Random secret of at least 32 characters (openssl rand -hex 32). Generate it once and keep it. Changing it makes stored integration credentials unreadable; re-save Settings → Home Assistant after a change.

Config.Name: Dashboard password
Config.Description: Required. Password for tablets that open the dashboard directly. At least 12 characters, different from APP_SECRET. Exact placeholder words (password, changeme, dashboard, …) are rejected.

Config.Name: Pexels API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Free API key from pexels.com/api for screensaver photos and videos.

Config.Name: Immich URL
Config.Description: Optional. Immich base URL (for example http://192.168.1.50:2283). Takes priority over Settings.

Config.Name: Immich API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Immich API key for screensaver media. Takes priority over a browser-stored key.

Config.Name: Music Assistant URL
Config.Description: Optional. Music Assistant base URL (for example http://192.168.1.50:8095). Takes priority over Settings.

Config.Name: Music Assistant Token
Config.Description: Optional. Music Assistant API token. Takes priority over a browser-stored token.
